adjudication.rationale: The new Admin::GroupsController endpoints `add_members` and `remove_member` use `params.require(:group_id)` and `params.require(:usernames)` / `params.require(:user_id)` (which will raise `ActionController::ParameterMissing` and typically produce a 400). The added specs under `context ".add_members"` and `context ".remove_member"` only cover the success path and the automatic-group 422 path, and always pass the required params; there is no test exercising missing-param/400 behavior for these new endpoints.
